fusions.name: Armour Needle
fusions.desc: A needle thrust that deals 5 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Plate
fusions.desc: Fires a stinger that deals 30 damage and ignores armour. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Barbed Cuirass
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and the attacker is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold-Set Wax
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
